title: p07-rereview-contract-completeness (accepted)
decision:
1. Amend D29/D57 only by adding Scheduling to scripts/module-layout.json::kernel_modules, between Observability and Settings (15 → 16), alongside ownership/glossary/constitution in P07.5. Keep the closed enum, R1, and exact ratchet baseline unchanged. Actual gate checks moved ten files; old list fails R1, new passes, unknown module still fails.
2. P07.1 AccountStatusGate uses AccountRef status and AccountRead::ownerIdentityId(accountId, centralConnection), AuthFactory::guard()->id(), and unchanged StatusGatePolicy. Do not extend AccountRef with persistence fields. Constructor now requires policy, resolver, read port, auth factory, central name; HttpRegistrar constructs it explicitly. Record the SpiKind::Call constructor BC delta in CHANGELOG/php-api/Golden and migrate callers. Existing suspended/grace owner/payment/export/read-only behavior, null-owner denial and named/path route matching must remain verified.
3. ScopeSessionToTenant injects TenancyManager, using nullable context() with TenantContextUnavailable::notInitialized. TenantContextResolver::current() is non-null and throws CentralContextException; do not append unreachable ?? to it.
4. DatabaseTenancyManager injects existing PSR LoggerInterface; internal TenantCleanupFailure keeps original getPrevious() plus cleanup Throwable property. Log both causes, tolerate log-transport failure, attempt all reverts and poison runtime. runFor skips restoration after poison, preserving the failure instead of replacing it with runtimePoisoned. When callback and restoration both fail, preserve both through the same wrapper. RuntimeRegistrar binds the logger; no package dependency/public interface delta. Tests check actual cause objects/log context and both central/outer runFor paths.
rationale: Ownership metadata alone cannot admit a new root module. AccountRef has no owner_identity_id. Typed context contract and prose-only cleanup diagnostics made the previous execution instructions incomplete. Original broad review confirmed all six D100 findings closed; these are additional defects, not reopened findings.
